root_cause: /afsluiten is not part of the localized routes and fills most of its text from script, so the static English build never translated it. English visitors left /en/prijzen for a Dutch checkout, including the terms line, the pay button, the trial text and the errors.
prevention: The checkout page carries its own English dictionary and a lang=en state that is remembered for the visit. A test fails when a visible text or a string passed to t() has no English translation. The English pricing page adds lang=en to every checkout link, also after the monthly/yearly switch.

evidence.runtime_status: verified in a headless browser on the built pages (EN pricing links, EN checkout texts and error message); production not yet verified after deploy

limitations: Mollie's own payment screen picks its language from the customer's browser; the checkout request does not pass a locale yet
Lifecycle e-mails are Dutch only until the copy is approved
